name: Neeko
notes: Inherent Glamour (P) and Shapesplitter's clone (W active) need an allied champion or a non-champion unit to disguise as or send the clone toward; with no allies, minions or terrain in this fight they contribute nothing, so only W's on-hit passive is modeled.

Pop Blossom is cast immediately at t = 0; its dossier is unsettled on whether the 1.25s wind-up blocks actions before the 0.6s cast time proper, so this kit takes the higher-impact reading (Neeko is airborne for most of it) and holds all attacks, Q and E until the full 1.25 + 0.6 = 1.85s has elapsed, when the damage lands. Its ~90-120s cooldown means it is never available again inside the fight.

Blooming Burst's up to two re-blooms occur automatically at a fixed 0.75s interval, since the dummy always counts as a hit champion; only the initial burst is treated as the 'cast' for on-cast item procs (Muramana, Spellblade, Eclipse) per the dossier's unsettled reading, the re-blooms are pure follow-up damage.
Q's and W's bonus monster damage is not applied since the dummy counts as a champion, not a monster.

Shapesplitter's passive is the only source of W damage in this fight: every attack adds a refreshing stack (cap 2), and the attack that reaches 2 stacks consumes them for a non-crit bonus magic on-hit strike; the bonus movement speed from both the passive and the active is irrelevant to damage.
Tangle-Barbs is cast as soon as its 0.25s cast time allows and thereafter on cooldown; its root duration does not matter since the dummy never acts.
Mana is not modeled: at level 16 the handful of Q/E casts over the fight window do not plausibly exhaust Neeko's mana pool.
